ev.q: Early release of selected estimates based on data from the 2007 National Health Interview Survey.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.

methods_quotes.q: Persons who refused to respond or who answered "Don't know" (approximately 5% of respondents combined) were not included.
